newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU Commission not bound by set-aside rate - Fischler.
newsitem.headline: EU Commission not bound by set-aside rate - Fischler.

text.p: European Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler said on Wednesday the EU executive council would make a proposal on the set-aside rate for the 1998/99 marketing year as soon as possible and was not bound by a farm ministers' decision to leave it unchanged at five percent.
"The Commission is free to make a proposal and that's what we'll do as soon as possible," Fischler told journalists after the ministers had agreed next year's farm price package.
In a statement issued after the end of the three-day talks, the Commission said Fischler respected the Council's right to suggest a set-aside rate.

But he added "this is a market management instrument and the rate should be established in an objective way on the basis of the most up to date information on the market outlook. This will be basis upon which the Commssion will draw up its proposal on set-aside."
